heroHeadline: Supreme Court issues notice to Election Commission over Form 6 changes, ruling the amendments were not court-ordered
heroSubtitle: The Cockroach Janta Party went ahead with its Oct 2 Gandhi Jayanti protest at Mumbai's Shivaji Park despite police denying permission, and Mumbai Police have since registered a case against organisers. The movement, which began over the NEET-UG paper leak and CBSE marking irregularities, now centres on demands for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation over the electoral-roll revision; Delhi Police separately registered three FIRs over anti-CEC protests with no individuals named. The CJP has said it plans to expand demonstrations nationwide.
